question.text: Under SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations 2015, a 'Designated Person' cannot trade in shares during the TRADING WINDOW CLOSURE. The closure typically starts:

answer.text: End of quarter till 48 hours after results announcement

explanation.text: The Logic: PIT Regs: trading window closes from the END of the quarter until 48 hours AFTER results announcement (unpublished price-sensitive information period). The Trap: 1-day is too short; 2-weeks before AGM is unrelated. Cross-Exam Context: III-A, III-C Compliance; XXI-B tests PM awareness for personal trading. Manager's Pro-Tip: PMs and their Designated Persons must have a structured pre-clearance process. Breach = SEBI penalty + reputational damage.
